title: Plum Jam

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: The plum tree is so heavy with fruit, its branches touch the ground! Today we make plum jam.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Jam needs just the right amount of sugar. Will you weigh it on the scales?

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Add scoops of sugar until the beam hangs level.
steps.hint: Is the beam tipping? Add a scoop, or take one out.

feedback.heavy: Too much! Take a scoop out.
feedback.all_good: Level! Plums and sugar, just right.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Now it bubbles in the pot, and the whole kitchen smells of plums. We'll have jam all winter!

journal_line: I weighed sugar for plum jam in Mrs. Hannah's kitchen.
